capability: Test where the clock, page and engine meet
title: Test where the parts join.

hook.picture: Close on the whale fitting three pieces on the line: a clock, a page, a small engine. Each has a green tick. Joined, the line stutters, and a viewer pod turns raw sienna ✕.
hook.words: All my tests passed. Then it froze.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every part passed its test. Together, the page froze.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: student shipping a first web app

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three pairs of parts, each tested alone in its own box. First pair meets: the line jolts at the join (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nobody tested the place they meet.

stakes.body: Green tests ship a page that freezes for real users, and the bug hides between owners.

solution_hint: Test the joins, not just the parts.

metaphor.body: The line runs through three parts, and a small gate sits on every join between them. The checks live at the joins, not inside the parts. Raw sienna alarm.

steps.picture: Three parts on the line: the clock keeps time, the page holds space, the engine does the work. The joins between them are dashed.
A gate drops onto each dashed join. A beat from the clock crosses into the engine; the gate rings and turns teal.
steps.words: Put the check right at the join.

steps.picture: Push-in: the engine hands the page a change off the beat. The join gate shuts in raw sienna and the line waits.
All joins glow teal with their gates, each labelled.
steps.words: These joins are seams. Test them first.

real_case.claim: ceti-clock-tree explains the browser host/guest stack (the event loop handles time, the DOM handles space, a compiled Wasm guest runs on both) and takes the stance that glue code is the only test.

honest_limit.picture: A fourth, faint dashed join nobody gated (a slow font file reaching the page) lets a delay through. The page stutters once. No gate rang.
honest_limit.words: A join with no check still slips.

not_this.body: Tested joins are not every join.

ending_pattern.body: The same three pieces snap together, each join clicking behind its gate, and the line runs in step with the clock.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's stutter at the join is gone: the join is gated, so the same assembly runs smooth.

end_belief.body: Test where your parts meet, not alone.

sound.signature: A metronome click that lands exactly
sound.problem_motif: Two clicks a hair apart, flamming

score_self.reason: Clear felt pain for learners, and the gate-at-the-join image is simple. The case is a repo stance, not a run, so it is labelled Illustration. "Clock, page, engine" may read as abstract without a voice.
